title: Survival-world-chat
description: This minecraft plugin adds a global minecarft chat!
body:
A plugin that adds a global chat and a staff chat!

How do you use it?

> First, you install the plugin.
> Then, you go into the config of one of your servers and change it to HUB. It's sort of your main server.
> Then it will generate a secret if the setting is enabled.
> On your client servers, you need to add that secret to the config!

The secret is like a password, so people can't just connect to your global chat!

Hope you have fun chatting globally!

Premission for staff chat survivalworldchat.staff!(For expample luckperms)
Note: Staff chat it aoutmaticly given to all the serverr op's!

Note: This is a new plugin. There could be bugs and problems. Please send us bug reports on the bug report page!

[Issue/Suggestion](https://survival-world.net/survival-world-chat)

This plugin is provided "as is", without warranty of any kind. Use it at your own risk.
